clauses.heading: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder
clauses.quote: Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (For the last 3 Financial Years) 5 Lakh (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have minimum average annual turnover of Rs 5 lakh over the last 3 financial years.

clauses.heading: OEM Average Turnover
clauses.summary: OEM of the offered product must have average turnover of Rs 25 lakh over the last 3 years.

clauses.heading: Years of Past Experience Required
clauses.quote: Years of Past Experience Required for same/similar service 3 Year (s)
clauses.summary: Bidder must have 3 years of past experience in same or similar supply.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is given for turnover.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No /Startup Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: No MSE or startup relaxation is given for years of experience.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Experience Criteria,Past Performance,Bidder Turnover,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,OEM Annual Turnover,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload experience, past performance, turnover, OEM authorization and OEM turnover documents.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 60000 /ePBG Detail
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 60,000 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents for their category with the bid.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers of goods or service providers qualify for EMD exemption; traders do not.

clauses.heading: (c)
clauses.quote: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall also be accepted by the buyer in the form of a surety bond.
clauses.summary: EMD may also be furnished as a surety bond.

clauses.quote: Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidder turnover must be proven with audited balance sheets or a CA/Cost Accountant certificate.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: the Bidder or its OEM of the product offered in the bid {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for number of Financial years as indicated above
clauses.summary: Bidder or its OEM must have regularly supplied similar products to government bodies or PSUs for the stated number of years.

clauses.heading: 2. Experience Criteria
clauses.quote: acceptance certificates like CRAC to be submitted along with bid in support of having supplied some quantity during each of the Financial year.
clauses.summary: Contracts and acceptance certificates like CRAC must be submitted showing supply in each financial year.

clauses.heading: 3. OEM Turn Over Criteria
clauses.quote: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document.
clauses.summary: The OEM must meet the minimum average annual turnover stated in the bid for the last three years.

clauses.heading: 4. Past Performance
clauses.quote: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have supplied same or similar Category Products for 50% of bid quantity, in at least one of the last three Financial years before the bid opening date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU.
clauses.summary: Bidder or OEM must have supplied at least 50% of the bid quantity to government bodies in one of the last three financial years.

clauses.heading: 2 Generic Manufacturer Authorization
clauses.quote: Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid
clauses.summary: Authorised distributors must furnish an OEM authorisation certificate with OEM contact details along with the bid.
